title: ProviderCredential
description: An upstream LLM provider API key held by the organisation, sealed at rest and projected to the gateway. Never carries the key: it is write-only (ProviderCredentialCreate / ProviderCredentialUpdate).

id.description: Public id of the credential — the same credential_id the gateway's projected config carries.

provider.description: Upstream provider slug. Set at create only. New providers may be added; tolerate unknown values.

label.description: Unique per organisation and provider (e.g. prod, staging).

fingerprint.description: Display form of the stored key, e.g. sk-proj…a91f (…a91f for short keys). Changes when the key is rotated; never reveals the key.
